comment: Start script time (ms) of the heaviest game pages in tests/eink-sim.js (Chromium, language de, cold load over the slow Wi-Fi, ScriptDuration up to load + 300 ms), measured on the Mac mini. tests/startup-limits.js fails when a page needs more than 50 % above its value at CPU 10. Change the values only on purpose, with a new measurement and date. sudoku, killersudoku, chess: report of task 104 (after the speed-up, one run each); futoshiki, sternhalma: the two heaviest other games of a run over all 103 games at CPU 10 on 2026-10-22, median of three runs. CPU 20 is kept for comparison and not tested.
